case6a_zero_frame_count.description: Valid Info header magic, but declared frame count field is 0. Valid LAME tag present.
case6a_zero_frame_count.soundfile_decode_mechanism: libmpg123 detects Frame 0 as Info header and skips it. However, because track_frames is 0, gapless playback mode (MPG123_GAPLESS) is aborted. All 78 audio frames are decoded in full without trimming encoder delay or padding (78 * 1152 = 89,856 samples).

pyav_numerical_reconciliation.frame_origin_clarification: The 47 retained samples belong to the first decoded audio frame (physical MPEG Frame 1) following the skipped Info tag frame (physical MPEG Frame 0). Physical MPEG Frame 0 is an Info tag frame skipped during header parsing; physical MPEG Frame 1 has 1,152 samples, from which FFmpeg skips 1,105 leading delay samples, leaving 47 samples retained (1,152 - 1,105 = 47).
pyav_numerical_reconciliation.trailing_padding_untrimmed_reason: In FFmpeg libavformat/mp3dec.c, end discard padding is calculated only if mp3->frames is non-zero ('if (mp3->frames)'). Because xing_declared_frames == 0, this check evaluates to false, leaving first_discard_sample unset. FFmpeg trims 1,105 leading samples (leaving 47 samples in the first decoded audio frame) but trims 0 trailing samples, retaining all 551 samples of end padding. Total decoded samples = 47 + (77 * 1152) = 88,751 samples (88,200 original PCM + 551 trailing padding).

case6a_zero_frame_count.scientific_interpretation: SoundFile declared length follows file-size fallback. Decoders diverge based on whether they trust partial LAME metadata when the container frame count is zero.

case6b_invalid_magic.description: Corrupted Xing magic ('Xung' at byte offset 36), declared frame count field is 78, valid LAME tag present.
case6b_invalid_magic.soundfile_declared_source: File-size fallback floor(16508 / 208 * 1152) = 91428 because Xing magic is unrecognized.
case6b_invalid_magic.soundfile_and_miniaudio_mechanism: Neither libmpg123 nor dr_mp3 recognizes 'Xung' as a valid header tag. Frame 0 (at file offset 0) is treated as standard MPEG Layer III audio payload and decoded into PCM, yielding all 79 frames * 1152 = 91,008 samples.

ffmpeg_control_flow.vbr_tags_parser_result: Returns -1 (no valid frame count or header file size established; mp3->frames == 0 and mp3->header_filesize == 0)
ffmpeg_control_flow.header_sync_loop_behavior: The malformed Xing/Info marker is not recognized. No valid frame count or header file size is obtained. Consequently, mp3_parse_vbr_tags() returns -1. mp3_read_header() detects the negative return value, restores the input position to byte zero via avio_seek(s->pb, off, SEEK_SET) and proceeds with the MPEG synchronization scan. The synchronization scanner searches up to 64KB for two consecutive MPEG audio frames satisfying (header & MP3_MASK) == (header2 & MP3_MASK), where MP3_MASK = 0xFFFE0CCF. Frame 0 header is 0xFFFB5000 (channel_mode = 00, Stereo; masked 0xFFFA0000). Frame 1 header at offset 208 is 0xFFFB5064 (channel_mode = 01, Joint Stereo; masked 0xFFFA0044). Because channel modes differ, (h0 & MP3_MASK) != (h1 & MP3_MASK). The consecutive header test fails at offset 0. The scanner advances to offset 208 (i = 208), where Frame 1 (0xFFFB5064) and Frame 2 (0xFFFB5264) match (both masked 0xFFFA0044). FFmpeg logs 'Skipping 208 bytes of junk at 0.' and executes avio_seek(s->pb, off + 208, SEEK_SET).
ffmpeg_control_flow.omitted_frame_explanation: Physical MPEG Frame 0 (bytes 0..207) is omitted from all demuxed packets because FFmpeg's header synchronization scanner classifies it as leading non-audio junk due to the channel-mode mask mismatch with Frame 1. Demuxed Packet 0 begins at byte 208 (Frame 1), delivering only 78 audio packets (16,300 bytes) to libavcodec. Because Frame 0 was discarded, its LAME tag is never inspected, gapless trimming is not activated, and libavcodec decodes all 78 demuxed packets: 78 * 1152 = 89,856 samples.

case6b_invalid_magic.scientific_interpretation: SoundFile declared length follows file-size fallback. Decoded samples diverge because FFmpeg's header synchronization loop skips Frame 0 as junk due to a channel-mode mismatch between the stereo Info frame and joint-stereo audio frames, whereas libmpg123 and dr_mp3 decode Frame 0 as audio.

decoding_analysis.soundfile_and_miniaudio_behavior: Both libmpg123 and dr_mp3 fail closed on incomplete final frames: each strictly requires the complete 209-byte frame before decoding. When EOF occurs at byte 109 of Frame 77, the partial frame is discarded, decoding only the 77 complete frames (77 * 1152 = 88,704 samples).

pyav_packet_and_decode_evidence.mpeg_parser_behavior: libavformat MP3 demuxer emits Packet 77 containing the 109 trailing bytes at EOF and delivers it to libavcodec.
pyav_packet_and_decode_evidence.av_input_buffer_padding_qualification: AV_INPUT_BUFFER_PADDING_SIZE (64 bytes) is memory-safety padding allocated after input bitstreams to allow optimized SIMD bitstream readers to read ahead without memory access violations. Direct empirical investigation proves this memory-safety padding does not synthesize compressed audio bytes.
pyav_packet_and_decode_evidence.origin_of_additional_samples: The additional 1,152 samples originate entirely from the partial 109-byte Packet 77, from which libavcodec emits a 78th audio frame (88,704 + 1,152 = 89,856 samples).
pyav_packet_and_decode_evidence.unresolved_decoder_mechanism_status: PyAV produced 1,152 more samples than the capacity of the complete physical MPEG frames. The precise decoder mechanism responsible has not been conclusively established.

mid_frame_truncation_investigation.scientific_interpretation: The structural parser accurately detects the incomplete frame and 109 trailing bytes. libmpg123 and dr_mp3 fail closed on truncated final frames, while FFmpeg decodes an additional frame from the partial packet. The precise internal decoding mechanism within libavcodec remains unresolved.

investigation_conclusions.hypothesis_confirmation: H1 CONFIRMED with exact mathematical proof: libsndfile delegates MP3 duration to mpg123_length(). In the absence of an Info/Xing frame, mpg123 computes duration as floor(file_length / bpf * 1152), using the total container file size (including ID3v2 tags) and unpadded frame size (bpf=208 for 64kbps/44.1kHz, bpf=216 for 48kbps/32kHz). Because mpg123_length() returns a positive estimate, libsndfile NEVER calls mpg123_scan(). The observed 1,977-sample shortfall on common_voice_en_21552119.mp3 decomposes exactly into 969 samples from the 175-byte ID3v2 tag and 1,008 samples from integer frame-rounding across 182 padded frames (209 bytes) and 4 unpadded frames (208 bytes). All 130 quarantined recordings independently match this exact formula with 100.0% accuracy (0 residual).
investigation_conclusions.governance_implications: The 1,977-sample shortfall is 100% a container estimation artifact, NOT physical stream truncation and NOT bitstream-reconciled gapless padding. However, because Protocol Section 14.7 strictly requires verified Xing/Info gapless metadata to classify as VALID_GAPLESS_PADDING, and because Task 7.7.2A is an investigation task with production validator frozen, all 130 clips remain safely in quarantine.
